2. Enrollment Course Suspension
In case of enrollment suspension/cancelation the vacancy can be ensured to the next academic year if the student inform us, in the 90
consecutive days, starting on the first days of classes. Please be aware that the enrollment suspension do not exempt students to the pay the
tuition fees, that must be pay in full on the same academic year of enrollment.1. Tuition fee – Payment types
I acknowledge that by enrolling in this course I have to pay the tuition fee in its entirety. The tuition fee for the course attendance is annual and
the student can pay in installments or in full (information available on the website of your course at NOVA IMS in “Admission and Tuition Fee”).
On the same page there is also information about the discounts that will only be granted upon request of the student on the first payment date of
the tuition fee (student must inform us if you want to pay in full or in 4 installments). For this purpose please send us an email to
sfinanceiros@novaims.unl.pt requesting the discount and respective proof of discount (if applicable).
If the student employer is the responsible for the payment of tuition fees, the student should also send an email to sfinanceiros@novaims.unl.pt
with all the information necessary for the invoice or can request through the Netpa Portal/Bursary/payments
3. Rules of Conduct and Code of Honor for the
I. Rules of conduct
1. Show good attendance and punctuality at lessons, seminars, conference sessions and other similar sessions promoted by NOVA IMS;
2. Actively participate in lessons, seminars and other similar sessions preparing their input and contributions, helping to enrich the debate and
critically discuss the relevant themes;
3. Show respect and good manners to NOVA IMS teaching and non-teaching staff;
5. Safeguard the resources that are made available to the student body as well as those that are intended for their academic advancement.
II – Code of Honor
Having the objective of the observance of ethical standards and the promotion of justice and equality of opportunity, and within the disciplinary
autonomy enshrined in legislation, the Student Body of NOVA IMS undertakes not to commit any kind of fraud during their academic career,
including:
1. Falsification of signatures;
2. Plagiarism in written work, tasks, projects or exams;
4. Personal Data
The data and information provided by the student on the accession of this term should be accurate , correct and true , pledging to inform the
NOVA IMS in case of any change.
The students credentials at NOVA IMS are the same in all applications except the e-mail user, here the student need to use the domain
novaims.unl.pt after the student number.
I acknowledge and accepted that by enrolling in this course I have to pay the tuition fee in its entirety even if I
suspended/cancel the enrollment in the course.
